title: Reading Drill — A New Use for Station Lockers
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: A New Use for Station Lockers
passages.body:
**A** A station offered empty luggage lockers to volunteers collecting clothes for a shelter. Donors were given a code to use only at agreed times so luggage customers could still use the majority of lockers.

**B** The organisers first collected donations weekly. When bags filled the largest compartments, they added a second collection and gave donors a maximum bag size.

**C** The trial exposed a transport issue. Volunteers needed a trolley to take items to a hired van, so the station reserved a small loading space close to the exit.

questions.prompt: Donors were given a ______ to use only at agreed times so luggage customers could still use the majority of lockers.
questions.instructions: Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS from the passage.
questions.explanation: Donors were given a code to use only at agreed times so luggage customers could still use the majority of lockers.

questions.instructions: Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS from the passage.
questions.explanation: When bags filled the largest compartments, they added a second collection and gave donors a maximum bag size.
